deadline.value: Complete applications by December 15 get full consideration for scholarships; the pool closes January 15.
deadline.quote: Applications completed by December 15 will be given full consideration for university scholarship programs.

gre_subject.value: The department says GRE scores are not required and are not considered.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required, and they will not be considered as part of the application process.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided on a holistic review of the academic record, not on a faculty agreement.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the program is based on a holistic assessment of a student’s total academic record as well as demonstrable promise to complete a Ph.D. in mathematics at MSU.

funding.value: The department offers a small number of research assistantships and a number of teaching assistantships, awarded by selection.
funding.quote: The Department of Mathematical Sciences offers a small number of graduate research assistantships (GRA).

entry_route.value: A bachelor's from a U.S. or equivalent non-U.S. institution is required by the time of entry.
entry_route.quote: By the time of entry into the Ph.D. program, the applicant must have received a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in the U.S., or equivalent from a non-U.S. institution.

toefl_min.value: The department catalog gives a TOEFL iBT 80 minimum, an old-scale score, so no number is recorded.
toefl_min.quote: the department requires that the applicant demonstrate a minimum score on one of the following TOEFL: 80-internet-based [iBT] or 550-PBT, or IELTS: 6.5, or Duolingo: 120

ielts_min.value: The department catalog requires IELTS 6.5 for admission; GTA appointments need 7.0.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required, and they will not be considered as part of the application process.

notes: Applications for the MS in Data Science are run by this department; there is no data science PhD here. Math Education PhD is not saved as a separate record.
name: Ph.D. in Mathematics
